faq.q: Can an Abbotsford house under $1.8M have a suite, a coach house or added units?
faq.a: A secondary suite must be within the principal unit, registered with the City, and less than 50% of the principal unit's size; a coach house or garden suite may occupy up to 15% of the lot to a maximum of 100 m²; and under the SSMUH amendment (Bylaw No. 3560-2024, adopted June 25, 2024) accessory units count toward up to 4 units on one lot in SSMUH areas — 3 units on lots 280 m² or less, 4 on larger lots.

faq.q: What are the house rules on ALR land at the rural edge of this band?
faq.a: Under the ALC's housing guidance, a principal residence is capped at 500 m² total floor area with a 1,000 m² fill limit, a secondary suite is permitted only inside the principal residence, and one additional residence is permitted up to 90 m² on properties of 40 ha or less or 186 m² on properties over 40 ha; City zoning (A1 subdivision minimum 8.0 ha; A2 16.0 ha) also applies.
